requirements.item_text: The product owner approves or rejects products made by a contract facility, including final release.

mappings.quote: owners are responsible for approving or rejecting drugs manufactured by the contract facility, 23 including for final release.

requirements.item_text: The product owner never places, or causes to be placed, any adulterated or misbranded drug on the market.

mappings.quote: In all cases, the owner must not introduce or deliver into interstate commerce, or cause to be introduced or delivered into interstate commerce, any drugs that are adulterated or misbranded.

requirements.item_text: No batch of a pharmaceutical excipient is released or supplied until the quality unit has released it, having assured itself that the batch was produced and controlled in line with the product specifications, applicable GMP guidance and any other rules on production, control and release.

mappings.quote: a batch of an excipient for pharmaceutical use is not released and supplied before it has been released by the quality unit with the assurance that the batch has been produced and controlled in accordance with product specifications, and with the recommendations in this document and any other regulations relevant to the production, control and release of these products

requirements.item_text: When the certifying person certifies or confirms batches remotely, this is done in full compliance with the applicable legislation and GMP guidelines.

mappings.clause_ref: Questions and answers on remote batch certification / confirmation by the qualified… Q2
mappings.quote: It is a prerequisite that the QP certification/confirmation is carried out in full accordance with EU legislation and EU GMP guidelines

requirements.item_text: In every case the certifying person performs batch certification or confirmation while located within the EU/EEA or Northern Ireland, and this location is proven by technical means.

mappings.clause_ref: Questions and answers on remote batch certification / confirmation by the qualified… Q2
mappings.quote: QP certification / confirmation should take place within the EU/EEA (or Northern Ireland) in all cases. This should be demonstrated by technical means.

requirements.item_text: The certifying person keeps up to date their knowledge of the products, the manufacturing processes and the pharmaceutical quality system.

mappings.clause_ref: Questions and answers on remote batch certification / confirmation by the qualified… Q2
mappings.quote: QPs are obliged to maintain their knowledge in relation to the products, manufacturing processes and pharmaceutical quality system.

requirements.item_text: The certifying person has satisfied themselves that their continued reliance on the relevant pharmaceutical quality system is well founded.

mappings.clause_ref: Questions and answers on remote batch certification / confirmation by the qualified… Q2
mappings.quote: QPs also need to be satisfied that their ongoing reliance on the relevant pharmaceutical quality system is well founded.

requirements.item_text: The certifying person can demonstrate to the competent authority their knowledge of the products and manufacturing processes they are responsible for.

mappings.clause_ref: Questions and answers on remote batch certification / confirmation by the qualified… Q2
mappings.quote: The QP must be able to demonstrate to the competent authority knowledge of the product and the manufacturing processes for which they are responsible.

mappings.clause_ref: Questions and answers on remote batch certification / confirmation by the qualified… Q2
mappings.quote: This should include time spent physically on-site as applicable.

requirements.item_text: Where batches are routinely certified or confirmed remotely, this practice is described and controlled within the pharmaceutical quality system.

mappings.clause_ref: Questions and answers on remote batch certification / confirmation by the qualified… Q2
mappings.quote: Where remote QP certification / confirmation is employed on a routine basis, it must be described and controlled within the pharmaceutical quality system

mappings.clause_ref: Questions and answers on remote batch certification / confirmation by the qualified… Q2
mappings.quote: relevant detailed site procedures should be in place
mappings.addendum: Detailed site procedures covering remote certification are in place.

requirements.item_text: Where national rules allow a contract certifying person who is not employed by the manufacturer, the technical agreement between the authorisation holder and that person covers remote certification and states the circumstances in which the person must attend the site.

mappings.clause_ref: Questions and answers on remote batch certification / confirmation by the qualified… Q2
mappings.quote: In Member States where use of contract QPs (i.e. a person who is not an employee of the manufacturer but conducting QP activities under the manufacturer’s authorisation) is permitted, the technical agreement between the MIA holder and the QP should also mention remote certification / confirmation, and specify the circumstances under which the QP must attend the site.

requirements.item_text: The certifying person has access to all data and computer system applications needed to decide on batch certification or confirmation.

mappings.clause_ref: Questions and answers on remote batch certification / confirmation by the qualified… Q2
mappings.quote: The QP should have access to all information (data and computer system applications) which are necessary according to Annex 16 to make a decision on batch certification / confirmation.

requirements.item_text: The manufacturing authorisation holder provides the facilities, equipment and support the certifying person needs to work remotely, including for electronic batch certification and for completing the batch certification register remotely.

mappings.clause_ref: Questions and answers on remote batch certification / confirmation by the qualified… Q2
mappings.quote: The MIA holder should provide the required facilities to enable QPs to carry out their functions remotely. This includes the equipment and support required to enable electronic batch certification / confirmation and completion of the batch certification register remotely.

requirements.item_text: The certifying person can demonstrate that they fulfil their wider duties under GMP, not only batch certification.

mappings.clause_ref: Questions and answers on remote batch certification / confirmation by the qualified… Q2
mappings.quote: QPs must be able to demonstrate that they are fulfilling their wider duties in accordance with Annex 16.

requirements.item_text: Every electronic action the certifying person takes while working remotely can be seen straight away by regulatory inspectors at the site where batches are approved for release.

mappings.clause_ref: Questions and answers on remote batch certification / confirmation by the qualified… Q2
mappings.quote: All actions carried out by the QP electronically at the remote location should be contemporaneously available for inspection by the competent authorities at the authorised batch release site.
